entities.description: The First Spirit, a King ruling in the East. Bael appears with a trinity of heads: a toad, a man, and a cat. He speaks in a hoarse voice. He causes the magician to go invisible. He rules over 66 legions of infernal spirits.

The Second Spirit, a Duke. He appears as a fair old man riding on a crocodile and carrying a goshawk on his wrist. He makes those who flee return, teaches languages, destroys dignities temporal and supernatural, causes earthquakes. Commands 31 legions.
The Third Spirit, a Mighty Prince. He is of the same nature as Agares. He declares things past and to come, discovers hidden things, and is of a good nature. Commands 26 legions.
The Fourth Spirit, a Marquis, appearing as a small horse or ass. He teaches all liberal sciences and gives account of dead souls. Commands 30 legions.

powers: account of souls of the deceased

entities.description: The Fifth Spirit, a President, appearing as a great lion that changes to human shape. He tells of hidden and secret things, causes and cures diseases, teaches mechanical arts, and changes men into other shapes. Commands 36 legions.
The Sixth Spirit, a Duke with the head of a lion and a thief's head, braying like a donkey. He tempts men to steal and leads them away. Commands 10 legions.

The Seventh Spirit, a Marquis appearing as a wolf with a serpent's tail, vomiting flame, or as a man with a raven's head. He tells of past and future, reconciles friends and foes. Commands 40 legions.

The Eighth Spirit, a Duke and Count, appearing in the sign of Sagittarius. He understands the singing of birds and speaks of hidden treasures, of things past and future, and reconciles friends. Commands 30 legions.

The Ninth Spirit, a Great King, most obedient unto Lucifer. He appears like a man sitting on a dromedary with a crown on his head, accompanied by a host of spirits with trumpets and cymbals. He teaches arts, sciences, and all secret things; he can bind men to the will of the conjuror. Commands 200 legions.

powers: binding of men to the magician's will

entities.description: The Tenth Spirit, a President appearing in Sagittarius. He teaches philosophy, logical and moral, and the virtues of herbs and plants; heals all distempers in man; gives good familiars. Commands 50 legions.

The Eleventh Spirit, a Duke appearing as a xenopilus. He tells all things past, present, and future, and shows the meaning of all questions, reconciles friends, gives honour and dignity. Commands 40 legions.

The Twelfth Spirit, a Prince with the face of a leopard and wings of a griffin, but changes to beautiful human form. He enflames men with love for women and vice versa, and makes women expose themselves naked. Commands 60 legions.

powers: exposing secrets of the opposite sex

entities.description: The Thirteenth Spirit, a Great and Terrible King riding on a pale horse before a company of spirits with trumpets and other musical instruments. He causes love between men and women. Commands 85 legions.

powers: causing love between man and woman

entities.description: The Fourteenth Spirit, a Marquis appearing as a gallant archer clad in green and carrying a bow and quiver. He causes great battles and disputes and makes wounds from arrows fester. Commands 30 legions.

The Fifteenth Spirit, a Great Duke appearing as a goodly knight bearing a lance and a serpent. He discovers hidden things and knows of wars and how soldiers should meet, excites love of lords and knights, and predicts things to come. Commands 60 legions.
The Sixteenth Spirit, a Great Duke appearing in red apparel and armour like a soldier. He causes women to love men and makes women barren. Commands 26 legions.

The Seventeenth Spirit, a Great President and Earl appearing first as a viper, then as a human with great teeth and two horns, carrying a bright sword. He tells of past and future, and reconciles friends and foes. Commands 60 legions.

The Eighteenth Spirit, a Duke appearing as a strong man with a serpent's tail riding a pale horse. He knows the virtues of herbs and precious stones and can transport men suddenly from country to country. Commands 30 legions.
The Nineteenth Spirit, a Duke appearing as a gallant soldier bearing a lance and riding a crocodile, wearing a duke's crown. He causes love between men and women. Commands 30 legions.

powers: causing love between man and woman

entities.description: The Twentieth Spirit, a Great King appearing as a man with the face of a lion, carrying a viper and riding a bear, preceded by many trumpets. He knows hidden things, can discover treasure and tell of past, present, and future. Commands 22 legions.

The Twenty-First Spirit, a Great Earl and President appearing as a great bull with a man's face. He teaches astronomy and all other liberal sciences, gives good familiars and knows the virtues of herbs and stones. Commands 30 legions.

The Twenty-Second Spirit, an Earl and Mighty Prince appearing like an angel with the head of a lion, a goose's foot, and a hare's tail. He knows past and future, makes men witty and bold. Commands 36 legions.

The Twenty-Third Spirit, a Duke appearing as a handsome man but with three heads — a serpent, a man with two stars on his forehead, and a calf. He rides a viper. He sets cities on fire, makes men witty in all things. Commands 26 legions.
The Twenty-Fourth Spirit, a Marquis appearing as a black crane fluttering about the circle. He restores lost dignities and honours and teaches rhetoric and art. Commands 19 legions.

The Twenty-Fifth Spirit, a President and Mighty Earl appearing like a dog with wings like a griffin. He teaches all arts and sciences instantly, knows past and future, causes bloodshed and manslaughter, and makes a man invisible. Commands 36 legions.

The Twenty-Sixth Spirit, a Strong Duke appearing as a dragon with three heads (dog, griffin, man). He speaks with a high, comely voice, changes the place of the dead, causes spirits to gather on graves, makes the operator rich and wise, and gives true answers. Commands 30 legions.

The Twenty-Seventh Spirit, a Marquis and Great Earl appearing in the form of a monster. He teaches the art of rhetoric perfectly, gives good servants, knowledge of languages, and favour with friends and foes. Commands 19 legions.

The Twenty-Eighth Spirit, a Mighty and Terrible Duke appearing as a soldier in red clothing riding a red horse with a golden crown. He tells of past, present, and future, turns all metals into gold, gives dignities, confirms them, and speaks with a clear voice. Commands 26 legions.

The Twenty-Ninth Spirit, a Mighty Strong Duke appearing as a beautiful angel riding an infernal beast like a dragon, holding a viper in his right hand. He tells of things past and future, discovers all secrets, teaches liberal sciences, and declares how the spirits fell. Commands 40 legions and is one of the three Princes of Hell.

powers: knowledge of the fall of spirits
extendedData.note: One of the three chief princes of the Goetia alongside Beelzebub and Lucifuge

entities.description: The Thirtieth Spirit, a Great Marquis appearing in the form of a great sea monster. He teaches and makes men wonderful in rhetoric, causes men to have good name and knowledge of all tongues, and causes love between friend and foe. Commands 29 legions.

The Thirty-First Spirit, a Mighty President appearing in the form of a strong man in human shape. He can teach the arts of logic and ethics, discovers the virtues of herbs and precious stones, makes men invisible and long-lived, can recover lost or stolen things. Commands 29 legions.

The Thirty-Second Spirit, a Great King appearing with three heads (bull, man, ram), the tail of a serpent, feet of a goose, breathing fire, riding an infernal dragon and bearing a lance. He teaches mathematics, astronomy, mechanics, and the arts. He gives the ring of virtues. He is destroyed if the magician asks the name of the god first. Commands 72 legions.

The Thirty-Third Spirit, a Great President and Mighty Prince appearing when the sun is in a southerly sign, coming in a human shape. He causes love and hatred, makes men insensible and ignorant, teaches philosophy and all liberal sciences. Commands 66 legions.

The Thirty-Fourth Spirit, a Great and Mighty Earl appearing as a hart with a fiery tail. He lies in everything unless compelled within a triangle. He causes love between man and woman, raises thunder, lightning and great tempestuous storms. Commands 26 legions.

The Thirty-Fifth Spirit, a Great Marquis appearing as a wolf with griffin's wings and a serpent's tail, vomiting fire. Changes to a man. Fights excellently well for the conjuror. Gives true answers to all demands. Commands 30 legions.
The Thirty-Sixth Spirit, a Great and Powerful Prince appearing as a crowned owl. He teaches the art of astronomy and the virtues of herbs and precious stones. Commands 26 legions.

The Thirty-Seventh Spirit, a Great Marquis appearing like the Phoenix bird, with a child's voice. He teaches all wonderful sciences and is excellent a poet, and willingly performs the conjuror's requests. Commands 20 legions.

The Thirty-Eighth Spirit, a Great Earl appearing as a stock dove with a hoarse voice. He builds up towns full of munitions and weapons of war, and sends men-at-arms to appointed places. Commands 26 legions.

The Thirty-Ninth Spirit, a Mighty President appearing as a crow, then as a man. He builds houses and high towers, brings workmen, gives familiars, and can break down enemies' desires. Commands 40 legions.

The Fortieth Spirit, a Great Earl appearing as a crow, changing to man's shape. He steals out of king's houses and carries treasure to appointed places, destroys cities, tells all things past, present, and future, causes love between friends and foes. Commands 30 legions.

The Forty-First Spirit, a Mighty Duke appearing as a man with griffin's wings. He kills men, drowns them in the waters, and overthrows ships of war. Has hope to return to the seventh throne after 1,000 years. Commands 30 legions.

The Forty-Second Spirit, a Duke appearing like a mermaid. He governs the waters and guides warships laden with ammunition, causes seas to be rough and stormy, makes men die in three days by putrefying sores. Commands 29 legions.

The Forty-Third Spirit, a Mighty Marquis appearing as a soldier with a lion's head riding a pale horse. He builds high towers, castles, and cities and furnishes them with armour, afflicts men with wounds and putrefying sores, and gives good familiars. Commands 50 legions.

The Forty-Fourth Spirit, a Duke appearing as a stock dove speaking with a hoarse voice. He takes away the sight, hearing, and understanding of any person, and steals money from kings' houses, horses, and divers things. Commands 30 legions.

powers: taking away sight hearing and understanding

entities.description: The Forty-Fifth Spirit, a Great King and Earl appearing as a lion riding a black horse bearing a viper. He can tell things hidden, of witches, and of things present, past, and future. He builds towers, overthrows stone walls, and makes the waters rough. Commands 36 legions.
The Forty-Sixth Spirit, an Earl appearing as a monster, then as a man. He makes men cunning in astrology and geometry, teaches herbs, gems, and woods, and changes dead bodies. Commands 6 legions.

The Forty-Seventh Spirit, a Great Duke appearing as a dromedary, then as a man. He procures love of women and knows all things past, present, and future, and sows discord among friends and foes. Commands 37 legions.

The Forty-Eighth Spirit, a President appearing as a great bull with griffin's wings, then as a man. He makes men wise, transmutes all metals into gold, and turns wine into water and water into wine. Commands 33 legions.
The Forty-Ninth Spirit, a Great Duke appearing as an angel. He speaks mystically of hidden things, teaches geometry and other arts, warms waters, and discovers baths. Commands 48 legions.

The Fiftieth Spirit, a Knight appearing as a cruel old man with long beard and hoary hair riding a pale horse bearing a sharp weapon. He teaches philosophy, rhetoric, logic, astronomy, cheiromancy, pyromancy and their parts. Commands 20 legions.

The Fifty-First Spirit, a Terrible King riding a bear with a hawk on his fist. He has three heads — bull, man, ram — with a serpent's tail and eyes of flame. He tells of past, present, and future, makes men invisible and witty. Commands 40 legions.

The Fifty-Second Spirit, a Duke and Strong appearing as a soldier riding a great horse with the face of a lion and eyes of fire. He teaches astronomy and all the liberal sciences. He gives good familiars. Commands 36 legions.

The Fifty-Third Spirit, a President appearing in the form of a thrush, then as a man carrying a sharp sword. He gives understanding of voices of cattle, dogs, and other creatures, answers truly in burning ashes and coals, and gives future knowledge. Commands 30 legions.

The Fifty-Fourth Spirit, a Duke and Earl appearing as a warrior riding a griffin wearing a ducal crown. He teaches philosophy perfectly, constrains souls of the dead to come and answer questions. Commands 30 legions.

The Fifty-Fifth Spirit, a Great Prince appearing as a horse, then as a man. He discovers all things past, present, and future, gives dignities, prelacies, and the favour of friends and foes, and will not suffer him to be tempted by any spirit. Commands 20 legions.

The Fifty-Sixth Spirit, a Duke appearing as a beautiful woman with the crown of a duchess riding a camel. She tells of all things past, present, and future, of hidden treasures, and procures the love of women both old and young. Commands 26 legions.

The Fifty-Seventh Spirit, a Great President appearing as a leopard, then as a man. He makes men cunning in the liberal sciences, gives true answers of divine and secret things, and can change a man into any shape so that he thinks himself to be that thing. Commands 3 legions.

The Fifty-Eighth Spirit, a President appearing first as a flame of fire, then as a man. He makes the operator marvellous in astrology, and all the liberal sciences, gives good familiars, can bewray treasures kept by spirits. Commands 36 legions.

The Fifty-Ninth Spirit, a Marquis appearing as a lion riding a horse holding two hissing serpents in his right hand. He teaches the virtues of the stars and knows the mansions of the planets, transforms men, and gives dignities. Commands 30 legions.
The Sixtieth Spirit, a Mighty Duke appearing as a lion with griffin's wings. He teaches all manner of handicrafts and professions, sciences, and philosophy. Commands 36 legions.

The Sixty-First Spirit, a Great King and President appearing first as a bull with griffin's wings, then as a man. He makes men witty, turns wine into water and blood into wine, and turns copper into gold. Commands 33 legions.

The Sixty-Second Spirit, a President appearing as a child with angel's wings riding a two-headed dragon. He gives true answers of hidden treasures and tells where serpents may be seen, and delivers them harmless to the magician. Commands 38 legions.

The Sixty-Third Spirit, a Great Marquis appearing with the head of an angel, the body of a raven, riding a black wolf bearing a sword. He sows discord and slays the master if care is not taken. Commands 30 legions.

The Sixty-Fourth Spirit, a Duke appearing as a leopard, mighty and strong, then as a man with fiery eyes. He gives true answers of past, present, and future, but if not in a triangle will lie. He burns enemies and gives visions. Commands 36 legions.

The Sixty-Fifth Spirit, a Mighty Marquis appearing as a peacock with a great noise. He teaches perfectly geometry and all things pertaining thereto, and also astronomy. He can transform a man into the likeness of a bird. Commands 30 legions.
The Sixty-Sixth Spirit, a Mighty Marquis appearing like a valiant warrior riding a black horse. He teaches grammar, logic, and rhetoric and discovers things hidden and lost. Commands 20 legions.

The Sixty-Seventh Spirit, a Duke appearing as a unicorn, then as a man. He gives excellent familiars, and can make trees bend at will, and gives concerts of music on command (but is not seen). Commands 29 legions.

The Sixty-Eighth Spirit, a Mighty King created next after Lucifer, appearing as two beautiful angels in a chariot of fire with a comely voice. He distributes presentations and senatorships, causes favour of friends and foes, and gives excellent familiars. Must have offerings, sacrifices, and gifts, or he will lie. Commands 80 legions.

The Sixty-Ninth Spirit, a Marquis appearing as a star in a pentacle, then as a man. He teaches the virtues of herbs and precious stones, discovers herbs, plants, and virtues of birds, and gives familiars of birds. Commands 30 legions.

The Seventieth Spirit, a Mighty Prince appearing as a beautiful man on a winged horse. He brings abundance of things, can carry things from place to place, can pass over the whole world in a moment, and discovers all thefts. Commands 26 legions.

The Seventy-First Spirit, a Mighty Duke appearing as a man with many faces of men and women, holding a book in his right hand. He teaches all arts and sciences and declares the secret counsels of any person. He can change the thoughts of men and cause love between them. Commands 36 legions.

The Seventy-Second and Last Spirit, a Great Earl and Mighty appearing in the form of a man holding a great serpent. He returns both a thief and the goods stolen; discovers all wickedness and underhand dealing; punishes all thieves and other wicked people and discovers hidden treasure. Commands 36 legions.
